catalog.summary: Hours, minutes and seconds of a time, all in view.

focusModel: roving tabindex, one stop for the hours, one for the minutes, one for the seconds, or one for the whole times

shape.units: hours, minutes and seconds, when the times are a step
shape.slots: whole times grouped by the part of the day, when options states them
shape.hourCycle: the four parts of the day are named under a 24-hour cycle and AM and PM under a 12-hour one
shape.reason: A list of times showed nine in a hundred of them and scrolled for the rest. The hour and the minute are two presses, and every one of them is in view.

wiring.aria-label: the consumer's own, on the root; each listbox is named by the family
wiring.aria-selected: true on the chosen option, false on every other one
wiring.aria-disabled: an option the bounds or the predicate refuse, which stays focusable; every option while disabled or read only
wiring.optionName: the time in words on an hour of a 12-hour cycle, where the number alone names two hours

keyboard.to: same column of the first row
same column of the last row

unavailable.hour: an hour is refused when every time in it is

dataAttributes.data-now: the hour it is, marked apart from selection
dataAttributes.data-unavailable: refused by the bounds or the predicate
dataAttributes.data-columns: how many units stand side by side

literals.columnCounts: Six hours to a row make a part of the day a row, and six minutes of twelve line up under them. They are the shape of a day, not a value a theme retunes, so they are written in the stylesheet as numbers.
